scope: Real Rust Core/SQLite and separate Rust Node on loopback TCP; actual built Svelte UI; no route mocks; not two physical machines
buildProfile: release binaries supplied by caller; executable SHA-256 authoritative

cells.resourceScope: Initial open, optional track/seeks and observation
Initial open, optional track/seeks and observation

resourceMethod: Win32 Job Object inclusive CPU/logical IO, root-process counters, sampled inclusive working set; cache file byte snapshots. Logical I/O is not physical disk I/O.
cacheContract: cold-app-preparation restarts both Rust processes and uses an empty preparation root, with persisted DB/Node inventory; OS disk cache not purged. Warm retains processes and prepared windows. No media content request is made before the timed click.

observationMethod.firstRawPcmMs: First non-muted playing selected element PCM above 1e-4 RMS, without video-playing, seek-position or drift gates; known fixture frequency identifies switched target
observationMethod.firstAudioMs: Legacy aligned PCM: video playing, drift <150ms and target/restore position gates
observationMethod.firstAnyPcmMs: Any playing external audio PCM, may belong to previous track during switching
observationMethod.initialPcm: Signed audio clock minus video clock at first raw PCM; sampled clock difference is not physical speaker/display synchrony

statisticalMethod.median: Arithmetic mean of central pair for even n
statisticalMethod.failures: All attempts remain in raw cells; successful early measurements are retained when a later action fails

artifacts.sourceAssociation: Artifacts supplied by caller; revision and observed source hashes are not an embedded build attestation. Executable/Web hashes identify the tested artifacts.

sessionIdentity: Distinct ordinary user account and server progress/preferences per simultaneous session; administrator used only for setup and separate HTTP probes.
